meta.author: OpenMedia
meta.summary: Hides the Popcornflix cookie bar and footer, and lets you blur or hide the hero banner. Geo-blocked outside the US, shell only.
meta.notes:
Checked 2026-11-13, logged out, headless Chrome over CDP with a desktop UA (1440x900) and an iPhone UA (390x844) on popcornflix.com/. The site served its shell and an empty catalogue: the content API returns nothing from this network (geo-limited), the page shows "No results found" and a hidden Access Error block. Everything below is about the shell.

LIVE counts (querySelectorAll on the live DOM): gdpr-bar both home 3; hero-blur both home 2; hero-hide both home 2; footer-links both home 1. Existing cookie rule extended with `#gdpr_cookie_info_bar-wr`, `.consent-box`, `.consent-box-mobile` (cookie bar with Accept All and Manage; present but `d-none` until the script shows it). Fixtures real.html and desktop-real.html are sanitised excerpts of the shell.

Choice: Featured banner Show/Blur/Hide (blur 14px) on the hero carousel and background poster.

NOT verified: the movie tiles, the player page, the hero carousel contents and any ad slots, because no catalogue loaded; no thumbnail or rail selectors were invented. Ads inside the player are video ads and cannot be hidden.
